Grassroots School Implementation Survey

A consolidated view of the on-the-ground implementation survey submitted by public schools across the eleven divisions of DepEd Region XI. Records are sourced directly from the division-consolidated spreadsheet and refreshed whenever administrators update the file — this site only presents and organizes that data.

Schools by Division
Record count and average implementation rate per division — click a division to see its full statistics
Implementation Rating Distribution
Overall rating band across all submitted schools
Average Score by Standard Area
Region-wide average across the six DepEd quality-standard categories (scale 0–2) — click a category to see its schools, lowest-scoring first
School Scoring Rubric
How the overall weighted mean translates into a descriptive rating — applied to individual schools and, on the Divisions tab, to each division's average
Overall Weighted Mean Descriptive Rating Interpretation
1.61 – 2.00 Highly Established (VE) The school has fully established and effectively implemented systems, processes, and mechanisms, with little to no issues requiring intervention.
1.21 – 1.60 Established (Es) The school has established and functional systems and processes, with minor gaps or issues that can be addressed through regular monitoring and improvement efforts.
0.81 – 1.20 Partially Established (PE) The school has partially established systems and processes; however, several gaps and issues remain and require strengthening to ensure effective implementation.
0.41 – 0.80 Emerging (Em) The school has limited systems and processes in place, with significant gaps and challenges that require substantial support, resources, and technical assistance.
0.00 – 0.40 Needs Immediate Support (NIS) The school has critical gaps in systems and processes that require urgent intervention, intensive support, and immediate corrective action.
Applied across six standard areas — Inclusive & Healthy Learning Environment, Learning Resources & Instructional Support, School Infrastructure & Connectivity, School Governance & Community Support, Teacher Development & Personnel Wellness, and School Security, Audit & Safety Measures — each scored 0–2 per indicator and averaged into the overall weighted mean shown above.

Connect to Google Sheets

Pull live data straight from your spreadsheet instead of this static snapshot.

Setup, once:
  1. Open your workbook in Google Sheets (upload the .xlsx to Drive, then "Open with → Google Sheets" if it isn't already there).
  2. Click Share → set access to "Anyone with the link – Viewer".
  3. Note the long ID in the sheet's URL, e.g. docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/THIS_PART/edit.
  4. Open the Cleaned Data tab and note its gid= number from the URL. Do the same for the School Summary tab.
  5. Build each CSV link as: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/SHEET_ID/export?format=csv&gid=GID and paste them below.
